executive_summary: Route one real e2e evidence-agent (testing-agent) run to a cheaper model via the Task-tool per-invocation override, and record the measured cost delta versus the Opus baseline in model_usage_log.

functional_requirements.requirement: Invoke a real e2e-evidence testing-agent Task via the Agent tool with an explicit per-invocation model override (sonnet) instead of the compiled default (opus)
functional_requirements.description: Use the Agent tool's documented model parameter, which takes precedence over the agent definition's compiled frontmatter (.claude/agents/testing-agent.md, which always emits model: opus per scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js:54 MODEL_TIER_MAP). The invocation must perform genuine e2e verification work (not a stub) against the SD-LEO-INFRA-E2E-VERIFICATION-ROBUSTNESS-001 parent's evidence surface, so the resulting cost/quality data is representative.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Agent tool call includes model=sonnet override
AC-2: The invoked agent performs real e2e evidence work and returns a substantive result (not a trivial echo)
AC-3: The invocation's subagent_type/label is recorded for later reconciliation

functional_requirements.requirement: Record the cheaper-tier run's actual token usage and cost in model_usage_log with tokens_source='caller'
functional_requirements.description: Since programmatic sub-agent execution paths (execute-subagent.js/executor.js) never call getLLMClient() for Task-tool agents, model_usage_log rows for testing-agent are self-logged via track-model-usage.js and carry empty metadata ({}). This FR requires deriving actual input/output token counts for the sonnet run from the session transcript (e.g. via scripts/effort-experiment/attribute-tokens.mjs, pinned to the specific agent-*.jsonl transcript file for this invocation to avoid misattribution under concurrent agents) and writing a model_usage_log row with populated metadata.input_tokens/output_tokens/duration_ms and metadata.tokens_source='caller'.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A model_usage_log row exists for this specific invocation with non-empty metadata.input_tokens and metadata.output_tokens
AC-2: reported_model_name reflects the sonnet override, not opus
AC-3: The transcript file used for attribution is explicitly named in the row's metadata to prevent silent misattribution to a concurrent agent's transcript

functional_requirements.requirement: Compute and record the per-run cost delta between the sonnet run and a comparable recent Opus baseline
functional_requirements.description: Using lib/cost/llm-pricing.js rates (opus: $15/$75 per 1M in/out; sonnet: $3/$15 per 1M in/out), compute USD cost for both the new sonnet run and the most recent pre-existing Opus testing-agent run(s) in model_usage_log, and record both figures plus the percentage/absolute delta in the SD's completion evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A written cost comparison (opus baseline USD vs sonnet run USD) exists in completion evidence
AC-2: The comparison cites the specific model_usage_log row ids used on both sides
AC-3: The delta calculation uses lib/cost/llm-pricing.js rates, not hardcoded ad-hoc numbers

functional_requirements.requirement: Do not modify the global MODEL_TIER_MAP flattening or leo_sub_agents.model_tier for TESTING
functional_requirements.description: Explore/Validation evidence confirmed the opus-for-all-tiers flattening in scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js:54 is a deliberate, documented architectural decision ('Thinking effort strategy: all agents use opus, effort is controlled via thinking budget'), not a defect. This SD must not alter that global policy; the cheaper-tier routing is scoped to a single explicit Task-tool invocation, using the harness's own per-call override, leaving the compiled-default behavior for all other invocations unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No diff touches scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js's MODEL_TIER_MAP
AC-2: No diff touches leo_sub_agents.model_tier for any row
AC-3: Completion evidence explicitly states the global policy was left intact and why

functional_requirements.requirement: Record a completion-flag finding distinguishing the two separate 'model routing' mechanisms discovered in this codebase
functional_requirements.description: This investigation found two unrelated mechanisms both called 'model routing': (a) lib/sub-agent-executor/model-routing.js's effort-based thinking-budget routing (real, wired into lib/llm/client-factory.js, used only by EVA venture-pipeline stage code, not by LEO sub-agents), and (b) the compiled-agent-frontmatter model field used by Task-tool LEO sub-agent invocations (always opus by design). Future SDs referencing 'model routing' for LEO sub-agents should not conflate these two systems. File this as a completion-flag finding, not a fix.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Completion flags capture explicitly names both mechanisms and their actual consumers
AC-2: No new SD is filed to 'fix' either mechanism as part of this SD

technical_requirements.requirement: Use the Agent tool's model parameter (this session's own harness capability) rather than any repo-level config change
technical_requirements.rationale: Confirmed via Explore evidence that no per-invocation override point exists inside this repo's generator/executor code path for Task-tool agents — the only override lever available without touching the deliberately-flattened global policy is the harness's own Agent-tool call parameter.

technical_requirements.requirement: Pin token attribution to the exact transcript file for the sonnet-override invocation
technical_requirements.rationale: scripts/effort-experiment/attribute-tokens.mjs's default heuristic selects the most-recently-modified agent-*.jsonl within a time window, which is unreliable when multiple agents run concurrently in the same session (a documented false-positive risk from prior SD work in this session) — explicit --file targeting avoids misattributing another agent's tokens/cost to this run.

technical_requirements.requirement: Cost computation must use lib/cost/llm-pricing.js as the single source of per-token USD rates
technical_requirements.rationale: Avoids drift between this SD's evidence and any other cost-reporting tooling in the repo (llm-cost-report.mjs, cost-governor.mjs) that already depends on this same pricing table.

system_architecture.overview: No new production component is introduced. This SD exercises an existing harness-level capability (Task-tool per-invocation model override) for one real e2e-evidence-agent run, and adds a small measurement step (token attribution + cost delta) around that single invocation.

components.name: Agent tool (Task-tool) invocation
components.responsibility: Executes the e2e evidence-agent (testing-agent) with an explicit model=sonnet override for this one run

components.name: scripts/effort-experiment/attribute-tokens.mjs
components.responsibility: Attributes real input/output token counts from the session transcript to this specific invocation

components.name: model_usage_log table (write)
components.responsibility: Stores the measured invocation's model/tokens/cost metadata for later reconciliation

components.name: lib/cost/llm-pricing.js
components.responsibility: Provides authoritative USD-per-1M-token rates used for the cost delta calculation

system_architecture.data_flow: Agent tool invokes testing-agent with model=sonnet -> agent performs real e2e evidence work, producing a transcript (agent-*.jsonl) -> attribute-tokens.mjs reads that specific transcript file and sums usage -> a model_usage_log row is written (source='manual'/tokens_source='caller') with the derived token counts and reported_model_name -> cost is computed from lib/cost/llm-pricing.js rates for both this row and a cited pre-existing Opus baseline row -> the comparison is recorded in SD completion evidence.
integration_points: Claude Code Agent/Task tool (this session's harness)

test_scenarios.scenario: Sonnet-override invocation completes and produces substantive e2e evidence
test_scenarios.given: The Agent tool is called with subagent_type=testing-agent and model=sonnet
test_scenarios.when: The agent performs real e2e verification work against the parent SD's evidence surface
test_scenarios.then: The agent returns a non-trivial result and a corresponding agent-*.jsonl transcript file is created

test_scenarios.scenario: Token attribution correctly targets the sonnet run's transcript, not a concurrent agent's
test_scenarios.given: Multiple agent-*.jsonl transcripts exist in the session directory from concurrent invocations
test_scenarios.when: attribute-tokens.mjs is run with an explicit --file pointing at the sonnet run's transcript
test_scenarios.then: The reported token counts match only the sonnet run's usage blocks, not a different agent's

test_scenarios.scenario: model_usage_log row is written with populated metadata
test_scenarios.given: Token counts have been derived for the sonnet run
test_scenarios.when: A model_usage_log row is inserted for this invocation
test_scenarios.then: metadata.input_tokens and metadata.output_tokens are non-zero, reported_model_name reflects sonnet, and metadata.tokens_source='caller'

test_scenarios.scenario: Cost delta calculation uses correct pricing rates
test_scenarios.given: lib/cost/llm-pricing.js rates (opus $15/$75, sonnet $3/$15 per 1M tokens) and the two rows' token counts
test_scenarios.then: The computed USD figures match a manual recomputation from the same token counts and rates

test_scenarios.scenario: Global model-routing policy is left unmodified
test_scenarios.given: The pre-existing MODEL_TIER_MAP in scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js and leo_sub_agents.model_tier for TESTING
test_scenarios.then: Neither the MODEL_TIER_MAP entries nor the TESTING row's model_tier value have changed

test_scenarios.scenario: No compiled-frontmatter regression for other agents
test_scenarios.given: The compiled .claude/agents/testing-agent.md (and other agents) prior to this SD
test_scenarios.when: node scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js is re-run after this SD's changes
test_scenarios.then: All agents (including testing-agent) still compile with model: opus in their frontmatter, since no source changed

acceptance_criteria: One real e2e-evidence testing-agent Task-tool invocation is executed with an explicit model=sonnet override, producing substantive (non-trivial) evidence output
A model_usage_log row exists for that specific invocation with populated token/cost metadata (metadata.tokens_source='caller'), citable by row id
A written cost comparison (opus baseline vs sonnet run, both citing specific model_usage_log row ids and using lib/cost/llm-pricing.js rates) is recorded in this SD's completion evidence
The global MODEL_TIER_MAP / leo_sub_agents.model_tier policy is verifiably unchanged by this SD's diff

risks.risk: Sonnet-tier e2e evidence quality may be materially lower than the Opus baseline, making the cost comparison misleading if quality isn't also considered
risks.mitigation: Record a qualitative note on evidence completeness/depth alongside the cost figures in completion evidence, rather than presenting cost savings as a pure win without the quality caveat
risks.rollback_plan: No rollback needed — this SD does not change the default routing for any other invocation; a single documented experimental run carries no lasting system risk

risks.risk: attribute-tokens.mjs's default transcript-selection heuristic misattributes tokens from a concurrent agent running in the same session window
risks.mitigation: Always pass an explicit --file argument naming the exact transcript for the sonnet-override invocation rather than relying on the recency heuristic (TR-2)
risks.rollback_plan: If misattribution is discovered after the fact, re-derive token counts directly from the specific transcript file's usage blocks and correct the model_usage_log row's metadata

risks.risk: This narrow, single-run scope could be read as under-delivering the parent SD's broader framing ('route e2e evidence-agent invocations' — plural, ongoing) if not clearly documented as an intentionally scoped first measurement
risks.mitigation: Completion evidence explicitly states this SD delivers one measured data point per the parent's stated per-child criterion ('one criterion, not the center'), and that durable/global routing changes are explicitly out of scope pending a LEAD-level decision on the deliberate opus-for-all policy
risks.rollback_plan: Not applicable — no durable change is made that would need rolling back

patterns_identified: Two unrelated 'model routing' systems exist in this codebase: effort-based thinking-budget routing (lib/sub-agent-executor/model-routing.js + client-factory.js, real and consumed only by EVA venture-pipeline stage code) and compiled-agent-frontmatter model selection for Task-tool LEO sub-agents (always flattened to opus by scripts/generate-agent-md-from-db.js's MODEL_TIER_MAP, by deliberate design)

model_usage_log rows self-logged by track-model-usage.js for Task-tool agents (e.g. testing-agent) consistently carry empty metadata ({}), because self-logging happens before any work is done and the attribution mechanism is fail-soft

scripts/effort-experiment/attribute-tokens.mjs already exists as the canonical way to derive real token counts from a session transcript after the fact, but its default file-selection heuristic is unsafe under concurrent agents
key_decisions: Do not modify the global opus-for-all MODEL_TIER_MAP or leo_sub_agents.model_tier — confirmed via VALIDATION and Explore evidence to be deliberate, not a defect, and changing it has an unenumerated fleet-wide blast radius outside this child SD's narrow scope

Use the Agent tool's own per-invocation model parameter (a real, harness-native lever, not a workaround) as the mechanism satisfying the parent SD's per-child criterion of 'one real evidence run at a cheaper tier with a measured cost delta'
